whoItsFor: Developers, including aspiring engineers, juniors, and experienced engineers new to a stack, who want to learn while building with an AI coding assistant. It keeps the user in charge of design decisions while the AI writes the code.
useCases: Learn how to plan a feature by reasoning through data relationships and tradeoffs before any code is written
Work through an unfamiliar existing repository by having the AI map the system before making changes
Practice anticipating failure modes and verifying results while keeping ownership of design decisions
